title: Image rights & provenance
description: Source, authorship, licence and processing records for images used on the BHOC Species & Biodiversity Protection Initiative website.
policy: Individual photo credits are kept off the main Initiative composition. This separate register preserves the source, creator, licence, verification date, processing history and reason for every displayed image.
rightsBoundary: Third-party terms apply only to the underlying photographs identified below. They do not license the surrounding BHOC text, branding, scientific materials, layout, design or code. No photographer, source platform or public agency is represented as endorsing BHOC or this Initiative.
